summary: Fin (Finley James Dawson) is a man anthro great white shark, born 1968-08-04, and works as a night marine rescue coordinator. Decisive, compassionate, modest, he brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.

fursona.description:
Fin is an anthro great white shark with a broad and powerfully built physique. Coloring: Slate-gray skin with pale underside; eyes: dark blue. Distinctive detail: crescent scar above right gill. Usual accessories: harbor jacket, rescue whistle.

Fin keeps a late schedule and is often at his liveliest after sunset. Those night hours bring him into contact with shift workers, travelers, and other people who enjoy a quieter city, but that routine does not define every part of his life.

personality:
Fin is decisive, compassionate, modest. He tends to notice the small details other people overlook, and he approaches new situations with a mix of curiosity and care. His work gives him a particular way of looking at the world, but he is happy to talk about plenty beyond the job.

He appreciates direct communication and makes room for other people’s boundaries. Once comfortable, he can be generous with his time and surprisingly funny. He has flaws and blind spots like anyone else, and he is willing to change his mind when given a good reason.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Counts everyone aboard before departure.
• Night routine: He often plans errands and social visits around his late schedule, choosing quieter hours when possible.
• Conversation style: He listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at his own pace.
• Work instinct: His experience as a night marine rescue coordinator can help him notice a relevant detail, but he is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: His species-specific features are part of ordinary life. He welcomes respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests:
Outside work, Fin enjoys marine charts, rowing and adventure novels. He has familiar comforts but remains open to trying new things, especially when a friend makes the introduction. He knows some favorite subjects well but does not need to be an authority on every related topic.

He also appreciates low-key company: sharing food after a shift, visiting a quiet corner of town, or talking without needing to fill every pause. These interests can change and grow through roleplay.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Fin while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers he is in the middle of his day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about marine charts becomes an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: A flare appears in a protected cove with no vessel nearby.
• A small favor: He could use a second opinion, a helping hand, or company while he handles a modest but unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or old story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes:
Use he/him pronouns for Fin. His gender, appearance, and species are aspects of a complete character, not a summary of his personality. He is an anthro great white shark with the traits described above; do not assume unusual powers or abilities beyond what the setting establishes.

Fin’s name, real name, birthday, history, job, and residence are fictional. The night schedule is a routine, not a requirement that he be unavailable in every daytime scene. He can make mistakes, form relationships, learn skills, and develop interests through roleplay.
